rv.q: It is a smart, intelligent play forcing one to think about the consequences of our actions involving financial and legal outcomes.
While the plotline on the fiscal fallout is thought provoking, the virus-related section is as irritating as its prickly and entitled main character.

The Difficulty Adjustment @ BEVERLY HILLS PLAYHOUSE November 14, 2026 by LADCC Critics Martín Hernández – Stage Raw "convoluted and halfway satisfactory play". @ AHMANSON THEATRE The Farce Awakens – Feydeau x 2 @ THE ODYSSEY THEATRE

cn.t: Critics are split on *The Difficulty Adjustment*. Some call it "electric" with "strikingly memorable writing," while others find it "convoluted and halfway satisfactory." Passionate performances earn praise, but the script divides opinion.
